# Hollow Knight: Silksong - Ultra-Wide

[![Nexus Mods](https://img.shields.io/badge/Nexus%20Mods-p1xel8ted-DA8E35?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.nexusmods.com/hollowknightsilksong/mods/32)

The author's release zip (v0.1.8) is kept unchanged. It bundles BepInEx 5, ConfigurationManager and the mod.

Removes the game's resolution and aspect-ratio limits and adds ultra-wide support, an FOV option, vignette and hero-light controls, a HUD offset and a splash-screen skip.

## Install

1. Extract the zip into `steamapps/common/Hollow Knight Silksong/` (the folder with `Hollow Knight Silksong.exe`).
2. SteamOS/Winlator launch option: `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winhttp=n,b" %command%`. Without it Proton uses its built-in `winhttp.dll` and the mod does not load. Not needed on Windows.
3. Start the game and pick the resolution in the game's video settings.

## Settings

Press F1 in-game to open the configuration menu. Settings are saved in `BepInEx/config/` after the first launch.
